reply_body: Bhai, samajh gaya — payment bank se kat gaya hai lekin app abhi bhi free version dikha raha hai. Screenshot zaroor bhejiye (transaction ID ke saath), usse humari team payment aur aapke account ko match karne mein madad milegi. Hum isko billing team ke paas bhej rahe hain aur plan activation status check karke aapko jaldi update karenge. Tab tak app ko ek baar logout-login karke dekh lijiye, kabhi kabhi status refresh ho jaata hai.
summary: User reports payment debited but plan still showing free version; requests activation, offers screenshot proof.
